C0163.title: Tech-Savvy Individual Sentenced for Developing and Selling Game Cheats, Illegally Profiting Over One Million Yuan
C0163.summary: A tech-savvy individual developed and sold cheat programs for a popular online game. The cheat could disrupt the game's program to increase the efficiency of earning in-game gold. The suspect made over one million yuan in illegal profits from selling the cheat and was ultimately sentenced by the court.

references.title: Tech Whiz Made and Sold 'Game Cheats', Illegally Earned Over a Million Yuan, Sentenced!
